derivation: neuter of a compound of G5064 (τέσσαρες) and G3376 (μήν);

occurrences.text: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.
